title: Native Canvas, Camera, Registration & Interaction Surface
objective: Deliver the accelerated native Scene canvas with presentation-only camera controls, selection and interaction, keyboard-accessible equivalents, GM/player projection modes, undo/redo and assisted user-correctable image registration while preserving canonical Scene, permission and owner-domain meaning.

repair_history.evidence: AIOC Repository Health run 33251087079 rejected the first governed-start head because required convergence fields were absent and RUNTIME_STATE_LIFECYCLE_REGISTRY still projected selected_not_started.
repair_history.change: Added the complete convergence contract and reconciled the runtime lifecycle registry before application mutation.

repair_history.evidence: Application run 33251326290 passed selector, invariants, install and typecheck on both platforms but the focused regression incorrectly searched the entire rendered UI for /hidden/i, matching the required safety explanation itself.
repair_history.change: Narrowed the test to assert absence of an actual unauthorized projection item (Secret dragon).

repair_history.evidence: Changed-evidence run 33251398813 again passed selector/invariants/install/typecheck but the focused regression used /PLAYER view/i, matching both the Player view button and the live status. Raw validation artifact 9714475439 was inspected before the repair.
repair_history.change: Entered diagnostic mode and narrowed the assertion to the live status phrase PLAYER view; zoom 120% without changing product behavior.

repair_history.evidence: Post-merge AIOC closeout Repository Health run 33251775501 on PR #788 reported only MVHEALTH-APP-SEALED-PROOF and MVHEALTH-SCORECARD-FAILURE-CLASS. Validator source and WORKFLOW_LIFECYCLE_REGISTRY were inspected and proved that application_family_proof.family_scope_merge must remain the stable MV-CONT-008 workflow-infrastructure merge d007dc980c63a7beab4ab9a4ddbc67525f8d7003 and that scorecard failure_class must use the fixed enum.
repair_history.change: Restore sealed-proof workflow-registry agreement while keeping ISE-01 feature proof separate, and classify the aggregate scorecard observation as repository_state. Product code, application proof, successor selection and implementation authority are unchanged.

preserved_boundaries: Existing Scene, World/Reality, Action/Event, Combat, Character, Creature, Item/Asset, Vehicle and permission authorities remain canonical.
Camera/view/bookmark/selection state remains presentation state and does not redefine canonical Scene meaning.
Generated registration assistance remains user-correctable and never becomes authoritative merely because confidence is high.
Hidden and GM-only state is permission-filtered before projection.

ISE-02 token/tactical movement, ISE-03 fog/vision, ISE-04 triggers, ISE-05 levels/reality, ISE-06 audiovisual orchestration, ISE-07 cockpit/recipes and ISE-08 multiplayer proof were not implemented by ISE-01.
Missing map/audio assets remain nonblocking; placeholders, silence and theater-of-the-mind remain valid.
No third-party media redistribution, paid provider activation, tester distribution, release or deployment was authorized or exercised.
